meta.title: LDC (Lower Deduction Certificate) Handling: refused for a user without the AP Executive role
gaps: Open and use LDC (Lower Deduction Certificate) Handling to apply vendor LDCs automatically during TDS computation
Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and verify that LDC Handling is refused or absent
Repeat the same action as an AP Executive and verify that it is available
Verify that the comparison uses the same Enterprise tenant and account role configuration
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open and use LDC (Lower Deduction Certificate) Handling to apply vendor LDCs automatically during TDS computation; Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and verify that LDC Handling is refused or absent; Repeat the same action as an AP Executive and verify that it is available; Verify that the comparison uses the same Enterprise tenant and account role configuration

args.need: sign in on the same Enterprise tenant as the user without the AP Executive role and as an AP Executive, then check whether LDC Handling is refused or absent for the first user and available for the AP Executive

steps.note: The role-specific accounts, tenant plan, and LDC Handling workflow are not exposed by any catalog step.
Confirm the session remains usable after the tester completes or skips the unavailable role comparison.
